description: Find US BUSINESS BANKRUPTCY filings by company name. Searches 1.55 million business filings across federal bankruptcy courts — no API key. Returns the case name, docket number, court, filing date, termination date and assigned judge. Use for "has this company filed for bankruptcy", corporate distress checks, counterparty risk and due diligence. Individual consumer bankruptcies are deliberately excluded.

company.description: Company name or a distinctive part of it, e.g. "Kmart".

court.description: Optional court id, e.g. "cacb" (C.D. Cal. Bankruptcy).

filed_after.description: Only filings on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

filed_before.description: Only filings on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: bankruptcy_search
title: Bankruptcy Search
